slug: 2026-01-27 Madagascar Tests Biometric ID System, Aims to Register 2 Million People by Mid-2026

systems.owner: Ministry of Digital Development, Posts and Telecommunications is the stated source
systems.tiers: pilot phase launched 27 January 2026 with senior officials; national launch planned for April 2026, two million adults targeted April to June 2026

note: Identity enrolment pilot; civil registry records are mentioned only as something the reform is expected to make more reliable.
